category: coding agent with a hosted model gateway and credit subscription

free_tier.stated: the platform plan is USD 0 for individuals; free models (Auto Free, `kilo-auto/free`, and models marked free) cost USD 0 and are limited to 200 requests per hour per IP; paid inference is billed at provider rates from purchased credits or Kilo Pass credits, with a 5% processing fee on credit purchases
free_tier.notes: the 200 requests per hour limit is per IP address, for anonymous and signed-in requests alike; three free models were listed on 2026-11-02 and the list changes when provider promotions end

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a coding subscription meters usage, not objects

interface_detail: the `kilo` CLI runs headless as `kilo run --auto "prompt"` (autonomous mode, built for CI/CD): `--format json` emits raw JSON events, `-m provider/model` picks the model, `-c` and `-s ID` continue a session, `--attach URL` targets a running `kilo serve` server, and the exit code is 0 on success, 124 on timeout and 1 on error; without `--auto` a non-interactive run auto-rejects every permission request. `KILO_ORG_ID` selects a Teams organization for `kilo run`. The Kilo Gateway takes OpenAI-SDK and Vercel AI SDK requests with a Bearer API key, and free models also with no key. VS Code and JetBrains extensions share the account
tooling: the open-source (MIT) Kilo Code agent, which the user installs as a VS Code or JetBrains extension or as the `kilo` CLI (`npm install -g @kilocode/cli`); the hosted Kilo Gateway serves the models and takes the user's own keys for over 30 providers; Cloud Agents run in Kilo-hosted containers
chaining: Auto Free and the gateway's free-model ids are a hosted USD 0 route that needs no card; Kilo credits or Kilo Pass pay for the paid models behind the same account, and the same balance works in the IDE, the CLI, Cloud Agents and the gateway; inference/kilo-gateway holds the gateway's free models and compute/kilo-code holds Cloud Agents

limits.value: free models: 200 requests per hour per IP address, for anonymous and signed-in requests alike; over the limit the gateway answers HTTP 429

limits_note: paid models have no gateway rate limit and stop at a zero balance with HTTP 402, and upstream providers may limit them; Teams is USD 15 per user per month, includes no credits and is documented as having no rate limiting at peak; Kilo Pass is a monthly credit subscription of Starter USD 19 (up to USD 26.60 a month in credits), Pro USD 49 (up to USD 68.60) or Expert USD 199 (up to USD 278.60), with a bonus of 10% in month 1, 50% in month 2 and up to 40% after on monthly plans and 50% every month on annual plans, bonus credits expiring at the end of each monthly cycle, paid allotments one calendar year after issuance, and a 5% processing fee on each Pass purchase
binding_note: on the free route the 200 requests per hour per IP binds first; on paid models only the credit balance binds

identity_cost.detail: free models: a Kilo account, made by signing in with an email address, ChatGPT, Google, Apple, GitHub, GitLab, Discord, LinkedIn or Anaconda, with no credit card; the gateway also serves free models with no account, limited per IP, and the CLI falls back to an anonymous provider when it holds no key. Teams: a GitHub account or a Google Workspace company email and a credit card for billing, while the 14-day Enterprise trial needs no card. Kilo Pass and paid credits: unverified: the payment method is behind a sign-up. The provider page names a temporary hold as identity verification without saying when it applies

reliability_note: free models are served by upstream providers that can limit a model on their own; Auto Free may route to providers that log prompts and outputs; the free-model list changes as provider promotions end
confidence_note: prices, limits, sign-in methods and the headless command are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-02, and the public model list from a probe of the unauthenticated gateway models endpoint. Nothing was subscribed to, so the Kilo Pass payment method and the free-route quality are unverified.
